benchmark.title: Windows Server Datacenter Local CIS Read-Only Benchmark

checks.title: Ensure Enforce password history is 24 or more passwords
checks.rationale: Password history helps prevent users from cycling back to recently used passwords.
checks.remediation: Set Enforce password history to 24 or more passwords in Local Security Policy or Group Policy.

checks.title: Ensure Maximum password age is 365 or fewer days
checks.rationale: Password expiration limits the time a compromised password can be used.
checks.remediation: Set Maximum password age to 365 days or fewer.

checks.title: Ensure Minimum password length is 14 or more characters
checks.rationale: Longer passwords materially increase resistance to guessing and brute force attacks.
checks.remediation: Set Minimum password length to 14 or more characters.

checks.title: Ensure Account lockout threshold is configured between 1 and 5 attempts
checks.rationale: Account lockout slows online password guessing.
checks.remediation: Set Account lockout threshold to 5 or fewer invalid attempts, but not 0.

checks.title: Ensure local Guest account is disabled
checks.rationale: The Guest account can allow unauthenticated or weakly controlled local access.

checks.title: Ensure built-in local Administrator account is disabled
checks.rationale: The built-in Administrator account is a common target and should not be used for routine administration.
checks.remediation: Disable the built-in Administrator account and use named administrative accounts.

checks.title: Ensure Windows Firewall Domain profile is enabled
checks.rationale: The host firewall reduces network attack surface.
checks.remediation: Enable Windows Defender Firewall for the Domain profile.

checks.title: Ensure Windows Firewall Private profile is enabled
checks.rationale: The host firewall reduces network attack surface.
checks.remediation: Enable Windows Defender Firewall for the Private profile.

checks.title: Ensure Windows Firewall Public profile is enabled
checks.rationale: The host firewall reduces network attack surface on untrusted networks.
checks.remediation: Enable Windows Defender Firewall for the Public profile.

checks.title: Ensure Microsoft Defender real-time protection is enabled
checks.rationale: Real-time protection provides continuous malware monitoring.

checks.title: Ensure Microsoft Defender Antivirus service is running
checks.rationale: Microsoft Defender Antivirus service should be active.
checks.remediation: Start Microsoft Defender Antivirus Service and investigate policy conflicts.

checks.title: Ensure SMBv1 is disabled
checks.rationale: SMBv1 is obsolete and exposes serious security weaknesses.

checks.title: Ensure Turn off multicast name resolution is enabled
checks.rationale: Disabling LLMNR reduces name-resolution spoofing opportunities.
checks.remediation: Enable the policy Turn off multicast name resolution.

checks.title: Ensure Windows Update service is running
checks.rationale: Windows Update must be available to receive security updates.
checks.remediation: Start and enable the Windows Update service unless managed by an approved enterprise update tool.

checks.title: Ensure Remote Desktop connections are disabled unless explicitly required
checks.rationale: Unneeded Remote Desktop access increases exposed attack surface.
checks.remediation: Disable Remote Desktop if it is not required, or restrict it with approved controls.

checks.title: Ensure AutoAdminLogon is disabled
checks.rationale: Automatic logon can store credentials and bypass expected interactive authentication.
checks.remediation: Disable AutoAdminLogon and remove stored automatic logon credentials.
